about.title: Westlake Village Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Westlake Village is a small Los Angeles County city of 8,507 residents, and in 2025 its public crash record showed 27 injury collisions and 39 people hurt, with no traffic deaths recorded that year. Even so, a wrongful death claim is never about a statistic. It is about one family, one empty chair, and questions that arrive faster than answers. Fatal losses in this community may trace back to a collision on Lindero Canyon Road or Agoura Road, but they can also follow a fall on someone else's property, a medical error, a defective product, or negligence far from any roadway. California allows a spouse or domestic partner, children, and in some cases other dependents or heirs to bring a civil claim for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect Westlake Village families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so you can ask questions without adding a bill to your grief.

whyChoose.title: What Westlake Village Families Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Only certain family members can file
items.desc: California gives first standing to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to specific dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who belongs on the claim before anything is filed.

items.title: Two years, sometimes less
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, or other government entity may be responsible. Starting early protects your family's position.

items.title: A civil case, separate from any criminal one
items.desc: A wrongful death claim seeks funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and compensation for the loss of love, companionship and guidance. It moves forward on its own track, regardless of whether prosecutors ever bring charges.

items.question: Westlake Village recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Can my family still have a wrongful death claim?
items.answer: Yes. Crash counts describe one category of loss in one year, and they do not limit anyone's rights. Wrongful death claims in Westlake Village can arise from a collision on Thousand Oaks Boulevard or Triunfo Canyon Road just as easily as from a medical error, an unsafe property, or a defective product. What matters is whether someone's negligence caused the death, not how many similar cases the city reported.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The law puts the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children first in line. If there are none, certain other dependents and heirs may qualify. Because eligibility depends on your specific family situation, an attorney can confirm who may join the claim and how any recovery would be shared.

items.question: The driver who caused the crash is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that belongs to the family, and it runs separately from anything the district attorney does. Waiting for a criminal case to finish can eat into the two-year filing deadline, so many families begin the civil process while the criminal matter is still pending.
